newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close weaker on expiry day.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close weaker on expiry day.

text.p: 1320 GMT - Austrian shares close weaker after volatile session overshadowed by expiry of January contracts, but traders say ATX index remains well supported.
* ATX index down 1.77 points or 0.15 percent at 1,166.77
* Expired January ATX future up 2.2 points at 1,169.0, February contracts up 1.1 points at 1,174.0
* Top decliner fibre-maker Lenzing, down 5.78 percent at five-month low of 620 ATS after company says it expects current-year group loss to exceed 1996's
* Creditanstalt preferred up 1.45 percent at 424 ATS after Bank Austria says it will offer owners of the stock to exchange their holdings into Bank Austria shares
* Top gainer Wolford, up 3.78 percent at 1,398.90 ATS
* Vienna Bourse index down 0.43 points or 0.1 percent 435.76 -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
